evidence.decision: Distinguishes core/complementary generation and significant action from editable suggestion.
evidence.artifact: Requires generation/control/consent flow and actual evaluation acceptance criteria.
evidence.transformation: Trip suggestions become labelled/editable and booking requires review of itinerary and cost.
evidence.verification: Fails disguised human authorship, blocked complementary work and uncontrolled consequential action.
evidence.applicability: Separates measured models from proposals and hardware/network/settings availability from assumption.
evidence.handoffs: Privacy covers transfer choices; Machine learning covers nongenerative predictions.
evidence.distinctiveness: Provenance, sensitive-trait inference, correction controls and model-swap reevaluation are specific.
